_meta.what: health settings: the v5.4 release row and its no-programme run under each variant, paired by seed; vsRef: the change in the programme's paired effect against the reference row (A against off, B and C against A); baseVsRef, progVsRef: the paired difference of the levels from the reference row, without and with the programme; offProgVsBase (safety-net rows): the release row without the safety net against this row's no-programme run, paired; erodeB (setting C rows): the share of setting B's savings per person-year that the row loses, no programme; avoided: public costs avoided per adult-year (2025 $), main and high, with the emergency-room part counted once under B and C
